verdict.rationale: Dagster models datasets as code-defined assets with declared upstream dependencies. Its Fivetran and dlt integrations represent ingestion sources as assets, and the changelog shows it emits column lineage for dbt snapshots, so the building blocks of source-to-table lineage are first-party. However, no evidence shows a user-facing end-to-end lineage view that traces each table back through its sources and transformations. Missing for 10: documented UI or graph view of end-to-end asset lineage, table-level lineage across non-dbt steps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I see end-to-end lineage of my datasets — which sources, steps, and transformations produced each table

citations.quote: `fetch_column_metadata()` now emits column lineage for dbt snapshots on dbt 1.12 and later
